claims.quote: Entecavir has a high antiviral potency, and resistance to it is uncommon; it is considered a first-line treatment for HBV infection.

claims.text: Tenofovir = the most potent oral HBV antiviral; minimal resistance.
claims.quote: Tenofovir is the most potent oral antiviral for hepatitis B; resistance to it is minimal.

claims.text: Preg, HBsAg+ w HBV DNA >200,000 IU/mL: tenofovir from 28 wks until delivery.
claims.quote: To prevent vertical transmission, pregnant patients found to be HBsAg positive who have HBV-DNA >200,000 IU/mL should be treated with tenofovir starting at 28 weeks gestational age until delivery
